title: Compass AI
welcomeLive: Live AI is on. It only reads your messages and words summaries. Records, permissions and the owner's rules decide everything. The four shortcuts use no AI.
welcomeDemo: Demo mode: no AI service is connected. Keyword rules, current records and the owner's rules run everything, and every workflow works in full.
repliesEnglish: Compass replies in your chosen language. Messages drafted for families, the owner's own policy text and saved notes stay in English.
welcomeIntro1: Hi {{name}}. Your bookings, policies and business context, brought together.
welcomeIntro2: Choose a starting point. We will work through it together.
welcomeFootDemo: Demo mode, no AI service connected
welcomeFootRest: plans need your confirmation · nothing is sent without you
stopped: Stopped. Your message is back in the box if you want to change it.
errorKept: {{error}} Your message is back in the box, so nothing is lost.
confirmNew: Start a new conversation? This clears the current one.
onlyTxt: Only plain text (.txt) files can be read. Paste anything else into the message box.
tooLong: That file is too long. Paste the part that matters instead.
addedFile: Added the text from {{name}}. Check it, then send.

voice.offCheck: Microphone Off. Check your words, then send.
voice.privacy: Voice typing uses your browser's speech service. Nothing is sent to Tutor Compass until you press Send.
voice.englishNote: Voice typing listens in your chosen language. Without live AI, Compass reads typed and spoken requests in English only, so use the buttons if it doesn't follow.

error.unsupported: Voice input isn't available in this browser. Try Chrome, Edge or Safari, or type instead.
error.blocked: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it in your browser's site settings, then try again, or type instead.
error.noMic: No microphone was found. You can type instead.
error.network: The browser's speech service couldn't be reached. Try again, or type instead.
error.noSpeech: I didn't hear anything. Try again, or type instead.
error.nothingCaught: I didn't catch anything. Try again, or type instead.
error.failed: Voice input couldn't start. Try again, or type instead.
error.unclear: I couldn't make that out. Try again, or type instead.

openLauncherTrouble: Open Compass AI assistant. Having trouble connecting

attention.label: What Needs My Attention?
attention.hint: See the priorities. Start with what matters most.

lesson_change.label: Lesson Change
lesson_change.hint: Find a new time that works.

msg.preparedCheck: Prepared. Check what will be saved, then confirm.
msg.couldntPrepareNothing: Couldn't prepare that. Nothing was saved.
msg.doneRefund: You can now process the refund in your payment system. Tutor Compass never moves money.
msg.doneLesson: You can now update the booking in your booking system. Tutor Compass doesn't change bookings.
msg.doneOther: You can now follow the next steps under this rule.
msg.saveIntro: Saving creates a request in Tutor Compass with this rule result. It doesn't refund money, change a booking or send a message.

card.genericError: Something went wrong ({{status}}). Nothing was changed.
card.didntGoThrough: That didn't go through. Nothing was changed.
card.previewReplaced: Preview updated. The earlier preview can no longer be confirmed.
card.previewUpdated: Preview updated. Check it, then confirm.
card.alreadyConfirmed: This was already confirmed, so it wasn't done twice.
card.expired: This preview has expired. Confirming will check the records again.
card.ownerOnly: Only the owner can confirm this. Send the request to the owner instead.
card.generated: Generated {{when}} from current records. Counts include every active request.
card.nothingWaiting: Nothing is waiting. No requests need a decision, a follow-up or an outcome right now.
card.page: Page {{page}}. Earlier pages are in the messages above.
card.largeQueue: This queue is very large, so ordering used the oldest 2000 requests. The count is still exact.
card.preparedAction: Prepared {{label}}. Check the preview, then confirm.
card.welfareRestricted: A welfare concern is recorded. The details are restricted to the owner, and none of it was sent to the AI service.
card.facts: Facts: from records, supplied and missing
card.readyText: The evidence is complete. Compass doesn't recommend an outcome.
card.notReady: Not ready for a clean decision.
card.outcomePrompt: What was done? For example, refund paid in the payment system on 20 October.
card.preparedDraft: Prepared to save the draft. Check it, then confirm.
card.copyBlocked: Copying isn't allowed here. Select the text and copy it instead.
card.staffChecks: For staff to check (not in the message)
card.neverSends: Tutor Compass never sends emails or texts. Copy the message into your email when you're ready.
card.checkedAt: Checked {{when}} against current records and your permissions.
card.nothingOutstanding: Nothing is outstanding. No decisions, clarifications, waiting workflows or failed actions need you right now.
card.couldntCopy: Couldn't copy. Select the text instead.
